parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
lin AS (
  SELECT empresa FROM public.agente_lineas_whatsapp
   WHERE phone_number_id = (SELECT j->>'pnid' FROM d)
   ORDER BY activo DESC LIMIT 1),
msgs AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversation_history (empresa, phone_number, role, content, message_id, created_at, importado)
  SELECT lin.empresa, m.tel, m.role, m.texto, m.mid, to_timestamp(m.ts), m.importado
    FROM lin, jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT j->'mensajes' FROM d)) AS m(tel text, role text, texto text, mid text, ts double precision, importado boolean)
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1),
pausas AS (
  INSERT INTO public.bot_pausas (empresa, contact_id, hasta, motivo)
  SELECT lin.empresa, p.tel, now() + interval '24 hours', 'respondió el dueño desde la app'
    FROM lin, jsonb_array_elements_text((SELECT j->'pausar' FROM d)) AS p(tel)
  ON CONFLICT (empresa, contact_id) DO UPDATE SET hasta = EXCLUDED.hasta, motivo = EXCLUDED.motivo, actualizado_en = now()
  RETURNING 1),
cadd AS (
  INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_contactos (empresa, telefono, nombre)
  SELECT lin.empresa, c.tel, c.nombre
    FROM lin, jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT j->'contactos' FROM d)) AS c(tel text, nombre text, accion text)
   WHERE c.accion = 'add'
  ON CONFLICT (empresa, telefono) DO UPDATE SET nombre = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nombre, public.whatsapp_contactos.nombre), actualizado_en = now()
  RETURNING 1),
cdel AS (
  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_contactos w
   USING lin, jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT j->'contactos' FROM d)) AS c(tel text, nombre text, accion text)
   WHERE c.accion = 'remove' AND w.empresa = lin.empresa AND w.telefono = c.tel
  RETURNING 1),
nota AS (
  UPDATE public.agente_whatsapp_cuentas SET sync_mensaje = (SELECT j->>'nota' FROM d), actualizado_en = now()
   WHERE phone_number_id = (SELECT j->>'pnid' FROM d) AND (SELECT j->>'nota' FROM d) IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING 1),
baja AS (
  UPDATE public.agente_whatsapp_cuentas
     SET estado = 'desconectado', ultimo_error = 'Meta: ' || (SELECT j->>'baja_evento' FROM d), actualizado_en = now()
   WHERE waba_id = (SELECT j->>'baja_waba' FROM d)
  RETURNING phone_number_id),
lbaja AS (
  UPDATE public.agente_lineas_whatsapp l SET activo = false FROM baja WHERE l.phone_number_id = baja.phone_number_id
  RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT empresa FROM lin) AS empresa,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM msgs) AS mensajes, (SELECT count(*) FROM pausas) AS pausas,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cadd) AS contactos, (SELECT count(*) FROM cdel) AS contactos_borrados,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM nota) AS notas, (SELECT count(*) FROM baja) AS bajas, (SELECT count(*) FROM lbaja) AS lineas_off;
